adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, `discourse_expires_in 1.minute` is executed unconditionally after the `if topic_id ... else render 'loading' end` branch. That means the `loading` response also gets the same cache headers/TTL as the successful response, so an intermediary/shared cache could continue serving the cached loading page for up to 1 minute even after the topic has been retrieved and would otherwise render highlights.
